source: Quest Helper plugin (github.com/Zoinkwiz/quest-helper), Scrambled! helper by pajlada; written out by hand for v1.0.2 and moved here in November 2026; checked against the OSRS Wiki quest guides (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), November 2026

items: Hammer, saw, 6 nails, 2 planks (all found during the quest)
An empty bowl (found during the quest)
rec: 40 Agility (for a shortcut to the dragon cave)

sec.n: Humphrey Dumphrey sat on a wall

st.t: Talk to Alan in Tal Teok Temple, north of Tal Teklan, to start the quest.

tr: Get to Tal Teok Temple, north of Tal Teklan, e.g. with a quetzal whistle.

sec.n: Wumty Scrumpty had a great fall

st.t: Inspect the egg in front of you.
Head south into Tal Teklan and talk to King in the pub.

tr: Walk: Tal Teklan is just south of the temple.

sec.n: All the king's horses and all the king's men…

st.t: Get an empty bowl from the Tal Teklan pub. You'll need it later.
st.tip: If it's not there, hop worlds or wait for it to respawn.

st.t: Talk to Acatzin inside the Tal Teklan pub.
s: I can talk to the blacksmith.

st.t: Talk to the Blacksmith, west of the Tal Teklan pub.
Take the hammer from the table in the blacksmith's.
st.tip: If it's not there, hop worlds or wait for it to respawn.

st.t: Get some nails from the blacksmith's workbench. You'll need them later.
Fix the whetstone.
Talk to the Blacksmith again to get a damaged axe.
Repair the axe on the whetstone.
Get the saw from the house to the south. You'll need it later.
st.tip: If it's not there, hop worlds or wait for it to respawn.

st.t: Return the repaired axe to Acatzin in the Tal Teklan pub.
Pick the damiana bush at the east entrance of Tal Teklan for damiana leaves. You'll need them later.
Pick up two planks beside the lake, a short walk south-west of the damiana bush.
st.tip: If they're not there, hop worlds or wait for them to respawn.

st.t: Talk to Kauayotl at the east entrance of Tal Teklan.
s: I see. Well, maybe I can help out with that?

st.t: Repair Kauayotl's cart.
Talk to Kauayotl again.
Talk to Nezketi in the Tal Teklan temple. He gives you an empty cup.
s: I can get you some tea.

st.t: Fill your empty bowl with water at the water pump near the east entrance of Tal Teklan.
Use the damiana leaves on the bowl of water.
Use the damiana water on the oven in the Tal Teklan General Store, just south of the bank, to boil it.
Pour the damiana tea from the bowl into the empty cup.
Give the cup of damiana tea to Nezketi in the Tal Teklan temple.
Return to Tal Teok Temple, north of Tal Teklan, and talk to one of King's men.

i: Nothing to bring. You pick up a bowl, hammer, nails, saw and planks along the way
tr: Everything is in and around Tal Teklan, so walk.

sec.n: Couldn't put Bumpty Numpty back together again…

st.t: Search the Eggs in the chicken coop south of the large temple. A level 16 large chicken appears: kill it, then search the Eggs again for a Large egg.
Cross the log balance towards the dragon cave.
st.tip: Needs 40 Agility. Without it, walk round to the cave entrance.

st.t: Enter the dragon cave, south-east of the large temple across the river.
Search the Eggs in the dragon cave. Kill the red dragon that appears, then search the Eggs again for a Dragon egg.
st.tip: Safespot: stand just south-east of the Eggs.

st.t: Leave the dragon cave.
Search the Eggs at the camp east of the dragon cave. Kill the black jaguar that appears, then search the Eggs again for a Jaguar egg.
st.tip: Safespot: stand just north-east of the camp.

st.t: Return to Tal Teok Temple. Give Kauayotl the Dragon egg, Nezketi the Jaguar egg and Acatzin the Large egg.
Talk to one of King's men to judge the replacement eggs.
Talk to one of King's men again to work out how to fix the broken egg.
Inspect the broken egg and put it back together.
st.tip: It's a jigsaw of 26 pieces. Tap a piece to turn it: it only fits once it's the right way up. Then drag it into place. Press and hold the puzzle-piece icon to see the finished egg.

st.t: Talk to one of King's men to finish the quest!

i: Antifire shield (recommended, for the red dragon)
tr: Walk: the chicken coop is just south of Tal Teok Temple, the dragon cave is to the east, and the jaguar camp is further east of the dragon cave.
